titulo: China expresses ‘grave concern’ as internal documents reveal suicide warning before death in Melbourne immigration detention
cuerpo: Exclusive: Serious questions raised about whether Chinese citizen was properly monitored at centre run by US prison giant Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The US private prison company running Australia’s immigration detention system was warned that a newly detained Chinese citizen expressed suicidal ideation and had a history of self-harm less than 24 hours before she died by suicide in a Melbourne detention centre, internal documents show. The death has raised serious questions about whether the detainee was properly monitored and whether she was placed in an appropriate room, given her state of mind. Continue reading...
